text: Working on it: the proxy balancers panic when they have no targets (rand.Intn(0) / modulo by zero) and the middleware then dereferences a nil target. Fix in progress in middleware/proxy.go; will report when verified.
Investigating router.go now (routing for a path with no routable match); fix and verification in progress.

Context.Scheme() currently returns unvalidated forwarded-header values; I'm making it ignore invalid X-Forwarded-Proto/X-Forwarded-Protocol/X-Url-Scheme values and fall back correctly. Verification in progress.

Fixed in context.go: Scheme() now ignores forwarded-header values that are not http/https (case-insensitive) and falls through to the next header, so an invalid X-Forwarded-Proto falls back to X-Forwarded-Protocol, and all-invalid forwarded headers fall back to "http".
